description: Maybach Ultimate Luxury is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development by Binghatti, located in the prestigious Meydan district. The project features two striking towers, each comprising a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine, five podium levels, and an elegant residential structure - with nineteen floors in Tower A and twenty-five in Tower B. Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Interiors showcase a contemporary aesthetic defined by clean architectural lines, premium materials, rich textures, and a warm, elegant color palette. Every detail is curated to reflect understated luxury and timeless style. Residents are treated to an exceptional array of lifestyle amenities, including a stunning infinity swimming pool, a shared jacuzzi, and dedicated outdoor yoga spaces. The development also features beautifully designed leisure and relaxation areas, premium beauty salons, diverse dining outlets, and well-equipped sports facilities. Complemented by valet parking and professional concierge services, every detail is thoughtfully curated to provide comfort, convenience, and elevated everyday living. Homes are envisioned as contemporary urban sanctuaries, offering elegant layouts, expansive views, and a strong connection to the surrounding cityscape. Premium materials, meticulous detailing, and high-quality finishes define both interiors and common areas, creating a living environment where luxury, precision, and timeless design converge. Location description and benefits Meydan is one of Dubai's most ambitious and prestigious districts, designed as a contemporary urban destination where luxury, nature, and innovation converge. Known for its expansive open spaces and iconic skyline views, the area blends modern residential developments with landscaped parks, waterways, and cultural landmarks. Meydan's master-planned environment offers a sense of scale, openness, and refinement rarely found in central urban locations. The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area's elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

raw_area: 67JW+P2W - Za'abeel - Al Kifaf - Dubai - United Arab Emirates, Dubai, Dubai
description: We offer for sale a 2-room apartment with a rental contract, with an area of 88 m² , in the popular Zabeel area. The apartment is located in the new residential complex 1 Residences. It is fully renovated and equipped with furniture and appliances. The offered apartment is on a high floor, with a well-thought-out and convenient layout, a spacious balcony, and panoramic views of the park. The bright interior is designed in a modern style in cool tones with marble and tiles. The apartment has 1 parking space in the underground garage. Starting price - EUR 585,830. There is currently an annual rental contract with monthly payments. The current return is 5-6% per year. There is potential to increase profitability by renting the apartment short-term. About the project 1 Residences is a complex of two original towers in the shape of the number "1" in the historic district of Bur Dubai. The 43-storey buildings are elegantly connected at the top levels by a skybridge. Construction of the project was completed in 2022. Infrastructure On the podium level of the complex and the top three floors, public areas with landscaping and premium amenities have been created for residents and guests of 1 Residences. These include swimming pools with lounge areas, fountains, children's playgrounds, a modern gym, a 340-meter running track on the 43rd floor, and much more. The 1 Residences complex is located in Al Kifaf, near Dubai's popular historic district of Bur Dubai. The area includes many historic sites: the Dubai Museum in 18th-century style, the historic Al Bastakiya quarter, and more. The active residence of the Emir of Dubai, Zabeel Palace, is also located here. The district's special attractions include the grand viewing platform Dubai Frame and Zabeel Park. The park can be considered a huge green oasis. There you will find dinosaur sculptures, illuminated gardens, an ice park with children's rides, barbecue pavilions, and a running track with non-slip coating and aroma diffuser. All these locations are within a 5-10 minute drive from the complex. It takes five minutes by car to reach Dubai's main highway, Sheikh Zayed Road, which runs along the coast. This highway provides quick access to any location in Dubai, as well as to the neighboring emirates of Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. The apartments in 1 Residences appeal to lovers of luxury and active lifestyles who want to enjoy comfort in a modern residential complex with unique architecture. The strategic proximity to the center of Dubai, business districts, and the airport highlights the convenience of living in 1 Residences.

description: Azizi Milan by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential destination in City of Arabia, Dubailand, inspired by the timeless elegance of Italian architecture and design. Drawing inspiration from Milan's renowned Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, the development blends distinctive architectural character with modern urban living. Its residential collection includes studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully planned to maximise functionality, natural light, and everyday comfort. Floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary layouts create bright, inviting interiors suited to both homeowners and property investors. Amenities and lifestyle Designed to bring resort-inspired living into an urban setting, Azizi Milan offers an extensive selection of more than 30 amenities. Residents can enjoy a state-of-the-art gym, swimming pools, landscaped gardens, and dedicated children's play areas, alongside convenient retail outlets and dining options within the community. One of the development's standout features is its expansive crystal-clear lagoon, creating a striking waterfront atmosphere and adding a leisure-focused dimension to everyday living. Combined with recreational facilities and community spaces, these amenities offer opportunities for relaxation, fitness, and social connection. Finishes and interiors The residences feature modern interiors, quality materials, and practical layouts that balance contemporary style with functionality. Large windows allow natural light to fill the living spaces, while the clean, modern aesthetic provides a versatile foundation for personalisation. Kitchen and appliances Equipped kitchens designed to provide everyday convenience and functionality. Furnishing Unfurnished, giving residents the flexibility to personalise their homes according to their preferences. Location and lifestyle Located in City of Arabia within Dubailand, Azizi Milan is part of a planned mixed-use destination designed to bring residential living, retail, entertainment, and leisure together. The wider area is envisioned as a vibrant urban community with a diverse range of residential options and lifestyle facilities. City of Arabia is associated with major planned attractions, including Mall of Arabia and the Restless Planet theme park concept. As development progresses, the wider district aims to offer a blend of shopping, dining, family entertainment, and recreational spaces within a connected community environment. Dubailand provides access to several established residential neighbourhoods and leisure destinations across Dubai. Road connections link the area with other parts of the city, making it a location to consider for residents seeking a contemporary home away from the busiest central districts. Combining Italian-inspired design, a broad range of amenities, and a lagoon-centred lifestyle, Azizi Milan offers a distinctive residential concept for buyers looking for modern living and potential investment opportunities in Dubailand.

description: Binghatti Spectre is a mixed-use development by Binghatti, presented under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." The project comprises two towers of contrasting heights rising above a shared podium base, with a sculptural, fluid silhouette. Residence formats include studios, apartments, and Royal Suites in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations, alongside dedicated office and retail space. The development is positioned as a contemporary residential and commercial destination, complemented by panoramic city views. Residents have access to a dedicated pool for adults and children, together with a yoga and aerobics platform and a paddle and tennis court for active pursuits. A children's play area sits alongside family sitting and social nooks, while wellness facilities and lounge sitting platforms provide space for relaxation. The development also includes an open lawn, a dedicated jogging and sprint lane, and activity tables with a ping-pong table for recreation. Interior layouts range from efficient studios to expansive three-bedroom residences, with the largest configurations featuring a private pool and a terrace open to the sky, plus dedicated laundry space. Rooms are organized around distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites in the larger units. The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout, and are delivered unfurnished. Location description and benefits Al Jaddaf is a vibrant and rapidly developing neighborhood located on the banks of Dubai Creek. Known for its strategic location, Al Jaddaf is situated between Dubai's old town and the bustling modern hubs of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This unique positioning makes it a desirable area for both residents and businesses, offering seamless connectivity to key parts of the city via major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, as well as easy access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro and Creek ferry services. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport further enhances its appeal as a convenient and well-connected neighborhood. The area is a blend of tradition and modernity, reflecting Dubai's rich cultural heritage while embracing contemporary urban development. Al Jaddaf is home to the iconic Dubai Frame, a major landmark that offers breathtaking views of the city, and the historical Dubai Creek, which retains its charm as a hub of the city's maritime and trade history. The area also features the Jameel Arts Centre, a cultural hotspot showcasing contemporary art and fostering creative expression, making Al Jaddaf an attractive destination for art and culture enthusiasts. Al Jaddaf offers a well-rounded lifestyle with a growing array of residential, commercial, and leisure options. It features a variety of modern apartment complexes, many of which boast waterfront views and state-of-the-art amenities. The neighborhood's emphasis on green spaces, including the landscaped walkways along the creek, promotes outdoor activities and a healthy lifestyle. With upcoming developments and a focus on enhancing community living, Al Jaddaf continues to grow as one of Dubai's most promising and sought-after residential and cultural hubs.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Exclusive Waterfront Apartments with Wynn Casino Views in Ras Al Khaimah Ras Al Khaimah, the northernmost emirate of the UAE, is renowned for its stunning coastline, majestic mountains, and rapidly growing luxury real estate market. This dynamic destination blends rich cultural heritage with modern infrastructure, offering residents and investors a high-quality lifestyle. One of the most anticipated developments in the region is the Wynn Al Marjan Island, the UAE's first integrated gaming and resort destination. Set to open in 2027, this mega-project will feature a world-class casino, luxury hotels, fine dining, and entertainment experiences, making Ras Al Khaimah a premier global tourism and investment hub. With its breathtaking waterfront views, expanding infrastructure, and promising economic growth, Ras Al Khaimah is quickly becoming one of the most sought-after locations in the UAE for luxury living and investment opportunities. are conveniently located just 3 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 6 minutes from Al Marjan Island Beach and Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, 13 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah Corniche, 15 minutes from Wynn Casino, 25 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and 55 minutes from Downtown Dubai. Designed as an exclusive waterfront community, this development seamlessly blends modern luxury with natural tranquility. It features five elegant 18-story towers, each offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Wynn Al Marjan Island. Inspired by traditional Arabic architecture, the exteriors combine earthy tones and contemporary design, creating a visually striking yet serene environment. Residents can enjoy direct sea access and an extensive array of world-class amenities, including a scenic promenade, state-of-the-art fitness center, coworking spaces, an entertainment room, multiple swimming pools, a kids' play area, jogging tracks, and championship padel tennis courts. For outdoor enthusiasts, lush parks, a dedicated pet-friendly zone with grooming services, and barbecue areas enhance the community's appeal. The development is further enriched by its proximity to the Royal Yacht Club, Al Hamra Golf Club, and an array of luxury hotels, fine dining, and high-end retail outlets, ensuring a sophisticated yet relaxed lifestyle. The project offers a meticulously designed collection of residences, including spacious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each crafted for modern comfort and elegance. Interiors are thoughtfully planned with open layouts that maximize natural light, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning sea views. High-quality finishes and premium materials create a sophisticated ambiance, complemented by neutral, earthy tones inspired by the surrounding landscape. Each residence is equipped with fitted wardrobes, ensuring ample storage space, and a fully integrated kitchen with high-end white goods, blending convenience with contemporary aesthetics. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly onto private balconies, offering breathtaking vistas of the Arabian Gulf. The master bedrooms are designed as serene retreats, with en-suite bathrooms featuring sleek fixtures and refined detailing. Smart home technology and energy-efficient features enhance everyday living, while spacious layouts cater to both relaxation and entertainment, creating an unparalleled waterfront lifestyle. description: Lunara Tower by Tarrad Development emerges as an exceptional residential address, a beautifully proportioned building of seven residential floors rising above a ground level and two basement levels, offering a curated collection of one and two-bedroom homes. Comprising one hundred and nineteen residences, this thoughtfully designed development achieves remarkable efficiency, with sellable area representing a remarkable proportion of the allowable gross floor area. Every residence has been carefully planned to maximise space, light, and comfort, creating a refined sanctuary where contemporary design meets everyday practicality. The amenities at Lunara Tower are thoughtfully gathered on a complete rooftop level, creating a vibrant social hub for residents to enjoy. The rooftop features a stunning swimming pool and a dedicated kids' pool, alongside a fully equipped gymnasium, a serene spa, and a beautifully appointed co-working space for those who work from home. Residents also enjoy a games room, a kids' play area, a multipurpose hall, a barbecue area, a padel court, and an amenities reception, ensuring that relaxation, wellness, productivity, and connection are all effortlessly catered for within the building. The residences at Lunara Tower are beautifully furnished, with every detail carefully considered to create an atmosphere of warmth and refined living. The interiors showcase a harmonious palette of ivory stone tones, champagne metal accents, and colourless glass, while continuous balcony bands, slender dark glazing frames, and sculptural supports establish a recognisable residential identity. Each home is delivered fully furnished with premium finishes, ensuring that residents can immediately immerse themselves in the comfort and elegance of their new home, while the chamfered corners and clear glazing articulate the building's presence on its three street frontages with quiet distinction. Location description and benefits Wadi Al Safa 3 offers a well-connected and increasingly desirable setting, positioned along three road frontages that provide excellent accessibility to the wider city. This thriving neighbourhood is served by the Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road as its principal regional connection, alongside Dubai-Al Ain Road and Umm Suqeim Street, ensuring that every journey is effortless and every destination within comfortable reach. The area's strategic position places it at the heart of a rapidly evolving district, where convenience and opportunity converge. The neighbourhood enjoys outstanding connectivity to the city's most popular destinations, with IMG Worlds of Adventure and Global Village just moments away, alongside Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai International Academic City, and Mall of the Emirates all within an easy journey. Residents benefit from proximity to the iconic Dubai Mall and Downtown district, Dubai Marina Mall, and Dubai International Airport, making both business and leisure effortlessly accessible. For global travel, Al Maktoum International Airport is also within comfortable reach, ensuring that the world is always close at hand. The surroundings offer a wealth of retail, dining, and entertainment experiences that enrich daily life, from world-class shopping destinations to vibrant cultural and leisure attractions. title: 78Q2+2Q, Dubai
description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: 38RG+77, Dubai
description: Laguna Residence is a distinctive residential development that reimagines contemporary living through an innovative lagoon-inspired concept. Designed to bring the tranquillity of waterfront living into an urban environment, the project features the UAE's largest podium lagoon, creating a resort-style atmosphere where relaxation, recreation, and modern sophistication come together. With its unique architectural vision and nature-inspired surroundings, Laguna Residence offers a refreshing lifestyle that balances the energy of city living with the serenity of a private retreat. The development comprises two architecturally striking towers, Tiffany and Cyan, each showcasing a distinctive design identity while contributing to a cohesive contemporary aesthetic. The residences feature premium finishes, including timber veneer accents, engineered stone surfaces, and marble-look flooring, complemented by a sophisticated interplay of light and dark tones. Smart home technology enhances everyday convenience, while equipped kitchens and intelligently planned layouts create functional and elegant living spaces. Every detail is designed to deliver a refined residential experience with a focus on comfort and quality. Laguna Residence elevates modern living through technology-driven features and an extensive collection of more than 30 indoor and outdoor amenities. Incorporating AI-powered features, the development aims to enhance convenience through smarter, more personalized living experiences. Residents can enjoy dedicated spaces for wellness, fitness, relaxation, and social interaction, complemented by the development's signature lagoon environment. This combination of innovative technology, resort-inspired amenities, and contemporary architecture creates a dynamic residential community designed around modern lifestyles. Location Description and Benefits Situated in City of Arabia, within the wider Dubailand district, Laguna Residence is part of an evolving mixed-use destination planned to bring residential, commercial, retail, and leisure experiences together. The area features a growing collection of residential developments, including apartments, villas, and townhouses, creating a diverse community suited to different lifestyles. Its master-planned concept emphasizes convenience, with opportunities for shopping, dining, recreation, and everyday activities within the wider district. City of Arabia is associated with major leisure and retail concepts, including the planned Mall of Arabia and the Restless Planet attraction. These proposed destinations form part of the area's long-term vision to establish a vibrant entertainment and lifestyle hub. As development progresses, the district aims to offer residents a broader selection of retail, dining, and family-oriented experiences, adding to its potential appeal as a residential destination. The wider Dubailand area benefits from road connections to other parts of Dubai, while ongoing development continues to shape its residential and commercial landscape. Planned infrastructure and leisure destinations contribute to the area's long-term vision, although individual projects and transport links may progress in phases. For buyers and investors, Laguna Residence offers a distinctive proposition through its signature lagoon concept, contemporary residences, and extensive amenities within an emerging urban community.

title: Emaar Ocean Star
description:
Ocean Star is a residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential buildings offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, combining contemporary interiors with a waterfront setting and access to the wider marina community.
The development includes 154 residential apartments, comprising 58 one-bedroom, 76 two-bedroom and 20 three-bedroom homes. The apartments feature practical layouts, spacious living areas and private balconies or terraces, with a range of configurations to suit different household needs. The supplied floor plans cover 38 layout variations, with total apartment areas ranging from approximately 789.9 to 2,025 sq ft.
One-bedroom apartments offer efficient layouts with private outdoor space, while two-bedroom residences provide additional room for families and shared living. Three-bedroom apartments feature larger interiors and, in selected layouts, substantially larger balconies or terraces. The combination of indoor living space and private outdoor areas contributes to the development's residential appeal.
Ocean Star is designed around a waterfront lifestyle, with a signature canal pool, landscaped green spaces and recreational facilities. Residents can enjoy access to a gym, recreational courts, a community park and a boardwalk promenade. The surrounding community also provides access to marina facilities, retail and dining options, and nearby educational and healthcare facilities.
Located within Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Star offers access to the waterfront promenade and the wider marina environment. Dubai International Airport is approximately 15 minutes away by car, while Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are around 20 minutes away. With its range of apartment sizes, waterfront setting and community facilities, Ocean Star offers an appealing option for end-users, families and investors seeking a home in Dubai's marina district.

Surrounded by crystal-clear waters and pristine beaches, it provides a unique blend of relaxation and adventure, featuring exclusive residential communities, luxurious amenities, and diverse recreational options such as golfing, water sports, and eco-tourism activities. Expansive windows and private balconies optimize natural lighting and allow residents to enjoy serene views of the surrounding natural landscapes, pristine beaches, and tranquil lagoons. description: VERDAN1A 4 is a contemporary residential development located in Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), designed to bring together modern architecture, nature-inspired surroundings, and sustainable urban living. Offering a diverse selection of studios, 1, 2, 2.5, and 3.5-bedroom apartments, the development caters to a wide range of lifestyle requirements, from individuals and young professionals to growing families. Its architectural concept emphasizes a harmonious relationship between modern structures and landscaped green spaces, creating a residential environment focused on comfort, wellness, and everyday convenience. The development offers a thoughtfully designed collection of lifestyle amenities that encourage relaxation, recreation, and community engagement. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool with a sun deck, a dedicated children's pool, a fully equipped gymnasium, and a welcoming clubhouse. Additional facilities include a children's playroom, outdoor BBQ areas, and a landscaped terrace garden, providing spaces for social gatherings, family activities, and peaceful moments. The combination of indoor and outdoor amenities creates a well-rounded residential experience for residents of all ages. The interiors reflect a contemporary design philosophy, featuring elegant finishes, carefully selected materials, and functional layouts that maximize comfort and usability. Each residence includes an equipped kitchen with modern appliances, offering convenience for everyday living. Apartments are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors according to their individual preferences while benefiting from thoughtfully planned spaces and refined contemporary detailing. Location Description & Benefits Located within Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), VERDAN1A 4 enjoys a position in one of Dubai's evolving residential communities, known for its growing selection of modern developments, family-friendly surroundings, and convenient access to essential lifestyle facilities. The area offers a balance between residential comfort and urban connectivity, making it an attractive destination for both homeowners and investors. DLRC benefits from connectivity to major road networks, including Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road, providing convenient access to key destinations across the city. Residents can reach established areas such as Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, and Motor City, while Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport are accessible through the wider road network. The surrounding area offers a growing range of retail outlets, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, educational institutions, and healthcare facilities, ensuring that everyday requirements are conveniently accessible. Its proximity to major family entertainment destinations, including Dubai Parks and Resorts, further enhances the area's recreational appeal, offering attractions such as LEGOLAND, MOTIONGATE Dubai, and LEGOLAND Water Park. The wider Dubailand district also provides access to various outdoor and sporting facilities, including parks, cycling routes, fitness destinations, and recreational spaces that support an active lifestyle. As the surrounding residential and commercial infrastructure continues to develop, DLRC is gaining attention as an emerging residential destination within Dubai. With its diverse apartment configurations, nature-inspired design, family-oriented amenities, and convenient connectivity, VERDAN1A 4 presents an appealing residential opportunity for end-users seeking comfortable modern living and investors exploring Dubai's growing residential communities.

title: Old Town, Umm al-Quwain
description: Modern Waterfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a natural sanctuary renowned for its unspoiled white sand beaches, clear blue waters, and rich biodiversity, including mangroves that provide habitat for species such as flamingos, turtles, oryxes, and gazelles. The island holds historical significance as the oldest pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf and is home to an ancient Eastern Christian monastery, reflecting its vibrant past. Recent developments aim to transform Siniyah Island into a premier destination, blending luxury living with ecological preservation while maintaining its cultural heritage. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 5 minutes from essential services, 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project is situated in a stunning island setting, blending refined waterfront elegance and lush natural beauty. Its exterior showcases contemporary architectural brilliance seamlessly integrated with serene sea views, sun-drenched promenades, and a dynamic marina. The residences boast direct access to a motorized seawater body, a yacht club with mooring facilities, and a lively promenade enriched by fine dining, boutique cafés, and vibrant nightlife. Residents enjoy podium-level infinity pools, cutting-edge fitness centers with marina views, cozy lounges, and engaging outdoor play zones. Expansive landscaped gardens and parks add to the tranquil setting, while a luxury hotel and a high-end mall offer indulgence and convenience. Additional features include a fully operational golf course, helipad, exclusive resorts, and seamless pedestrian connectivity via a scenic bridge, all thoughtfully designed to elevate coastal living into a lifestyle of refined leisure and adventure. The project presents a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, where modern design meets exceptional functionality across three residential towers. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: DIFC - Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai
raw_area: DIFC - Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai, Dubai
description: Project general facts The Residences by DIFC mark the first residential chapter within the visionary DIFC Zabeel District, redefining contemporary urban living in the very heart of Dubai. Comprising two architecturally striking towers with sculptural silhouettes, the project introduces a refined residential destination seamlessly integrated into a dynamic mixed-use environment. Designed as an extension of DIFC's prestigious legacy, the development blends business, culture, lifestyle, and leisure into a cohesive urban ecosystem, offering residents iconic views across Dubai's most prominent landmarks. Residents of The Residences by DIFC enjoy a carefully curated collection of premium, hotel-inspired amenities designed to elevate everyday living. These include resort-style swimming pools, wellness and fitness facilities, dedicated yoga and relaxation spaces, and elegant residents' lounges for socialising or quiet retreat. Thoughtfully designed communal areas provide spaces for work, leisure, and connection, while landscaped terraces and outdoor zones create a sense of calm within the urban setting. Complementing the private amenities, the project is enriched by direct access to the pedestrian boulevard, high-end retail and dining, and the Inner Circle green loop - a continuous landscaped pathway encouraging walking, wellness, and community interaction. The residential collection features refined apartments and duplex penthouses with intelligently planned layouts that prioritise space, light, and comfort. Interiors are defined by a timeless aesthetic, premium materials, and a sophisticated palette that reflects the understated elegance of DIFC. With seamless connectivity to Gate District, Emirates Towers, the Museum of the Future, and Dubai World Trade Centre via the Future Loop, The Residences by DIFC offer a rare opportunity to live at the intersection of prestige, connectivity, and elevated urban lifestyle. Location description and benefits DIFC Zabeel District is a urban extension of the Dubai International Financial Centre, positioned at the intersection of Dubai's most established business, lifestyle, and residential destinations. Strategically located between DIFC, Downtown Dubai, Zabeel Park, and the World Trade Centre corridor, the district benefits from direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road and key city arteries. This prime positioning places residents within minutes of Dubai's financial core, cultural landmarks, and global business hubs, while maintaining a sense of exclusivity and urban refinement. The district is conceived as a fully integrated, mixed-use urban quarter that seamlessly blends residential, commercial, retail, and lifestyle components. Thoughtfully planned pedestrian routes, shaded boulevards, landscaped public spaces, and curated retail and dining destinations form the backbone of the neighborhood. The master plan emphasizes walkability, connectivity, and a human-scale urban experience, transforming DIFC Zabeel District into a vibrant, self-sustained environment that supports both professional and everyday living. DIFC Zabeel District is designed to cater to a cosmopolitan audience seeking a dynamic yet balanced lifestyle. The area combines the prestige and global reputation of DIFC with contemporary urban living, offering proximity to offices, cultural venues, hospitality, and leisure destinations within a single cohesive district. With its emphasis on quality placemaking, integrated amenities, and long-term urban value, DIFC Zabeel District is positioned as one of Dubai's most forward-looking and desirable central neighborhoods.

title: Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai
description: Project general facts Interstellar Tower is a visionary addition to the urban skyline, distinguished by its sleek futuristic architecture and bold contemporary design. Located in a prime area, the development embodies innovation and modern elegance, creating a striking architectural landmark. Its thoughtfully designed residences feature spacious layouts, expansive windows, and sophisticated interiors that maximize natural light while delivering a harmonious balance of comfort, style, and functionality. Residents enjoy a carefully curated selection of lifestyle amenities, including a panoramic infinity pool, landscaped sky garden, dedicated wellness and fitness facilities, coworking spaces, and inviting community areas. Together, these amenities create a vibrant environment where relaxation, productivity, and social connection come together to enhance everyday living. Each residence features stylish interiors that combine contemporary design with natural materials, complemented by premium lighting from Zonda Lighting. The apartments include fully fitted kitchens equipped with Bosch appliances and are delivered with built-in wardrobes and cabinetry by Fabel Casa, providing elegant, functional living spaces ready for everyday comfort. Location description and benefits Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT) is a well-planned residential district in Dubai that seamlessly blends tranquility with convenience. The neighborhood features a mix of villas, townhouses, and apartments surrounded by lush landscaping and parks. The circular layout of JVT ensures easy navigation, while the ample green spaces provide a peaceful retreat for residents seeking a serene lifestyle away from the city's hustle and bustle. JVT offers a wide array of amenities, catering to both families and individuals. The community includes schools, supermarkets, healthcare facilities, and fitness centers, ensuring that all daily needs are met within a short distance. Its numerous parks, jogging tracks, and cycling paths encourage an active lifestyle, while the vibrant community center and retail outlets provide spaces for shopping and socializing. Conveniently located near major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, JVT offers excellent connectivity to Dubai's key destinations, including Dubai Marina, JBR, and Downtown Dubai. Designed with a focus on blending modern architecture with natural surroundings, JVT features thoughtfully planned infrastructure, emphasizing sustainability and livability. Water features and landscaped gardens add to the charm of this tranquil community, making it an ideal choice for those looking to enjoy modern conveniences in a peaceful, green setting. Whether you're looking for a family-oriented community or a relaxing space to call home, JVT offers the perfect balance of lifestyle and location.

title: Mina Jebel Ali, Dubai
description: Raw District is a premium mixed-use development. Conceived as an "urban lifestyle philosophy" rather than a conventional residential project, the development is designed as a dynamic cultural hub where living, working, and social interaction seamlessly intersect. Its architecture embraces a raw, minimalistic aesthetic with open, adaptable spaces that prioritize functionality, movement, and continuous evolution.The project offers a wide range of fully furnished residences, including studios, 1- to 3-bedroom apartments, alongside office and retail spaces. Raw District stands out for its extensive and unconventional amenities, curated to foster creativity, collaboration, and community engagement. Rather than traditional leisure facilities, the project introduces concept-driven spaces such as creative studios, podcast rooms, co-working hubs, wellness zones, indoor and outdoor cinemas, and curated dining experiences. Signature features like the District Table, design labs, and maker spaces create an ecosystem where residents and professionals can connect, create, and evolve - forming a vibrant, ever-changing environment tailored to a new generation of urban living. Interiors follow a clean, stripped-back design language focused on efficiency and comfort, featuring open-plan kitchens, integrated appliances, smart storage solutions, and smart home technology. The layouts are thoughtfully designed to support modern urban lifestyles, balancing practicality with understated elegance. A strong emphasis is placed on furnishing and interior detailing, with residences delivered fully furnished in a refined, minimalist style that prioritizes clarity, usability, and quiet sophistication. Additional features such as acoustic treatments, smart home integration, and high-quality fittings further elevate everyday living, ensuring each space feels cohesive, functional, and effortlessly livable. Location description and benefits Jebel Ali is a renowned district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, strategically set along the Arabian Gulf coastline. At its heart lies Jebel Ali Port, one of the world's largest container hubs, which has cemented the area's global significance in trade and commerce. Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination.

Its curved edge follows Aqua Arc's wave-inspired architecture and gives the home a genuine outdoor room rather than a token balcony. The residence carries a community outlook. It is therefore best suited to a buyer who values interior scale, usable outdoor space and a calmer inward-facing position over a direct-sea premium. title: Union Takaya
description:
Takaya is being developed by Union Properties beside Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It combines three towers: Takaya Tower rises 29 floors above ground, basement and podium levels, while Symphony and Harmony each have 19. Townhouses and villas sit around a shared podium, for a total of 744 apartments, 39 townhouses and five villas plus retail units. Apartments run from studios to four bedrooms, with one- to four-bedroom layouts of 831 sq ft to 2,339 sq ft, and the four-bedroom townhouses are set over three levels with a roof terrace.

Homes are handed over semi-furnished, with soft pastel interiors and kitchens fitted with Siemens appliances; many layouts add a maid's room and walk-in wardrobes. The 24 shared amenities include lap, recreational and children's pools, three gyms, two squash courts, a paddle tennis court, a golf simulator, a cinema room, co-working spaces, a children's day care and a sky garden. Parking is provided for 1,203 cars, 100 of them enabled for EV charging. A landscaped retail plaza sits at street level, and Motor City's gardens, cycle paths and the Dubai Outdoor Kartdrome are nearby.

Union Properties, founded in 1987 and publicly listed, is the developer behind Motor City, Dubai Autodrome and Uptown Mirdif, and has delivered more than 10,000 units in Dubai. Takaya adds a broad spread of apartment sizes and a limited number of townhouses and villas to this established community between major highways. The payment plan asks for 5% on booking and 15% during construction, with the remaining 80% due on handover, expected in Q4 2027.

The area benefits from convenient access to major road networks, enabling smooth movement across Dubai and easy reach of key business, retail, and leisure destinations. This accessibility supports effortless daily routines while preserving a feeling of separation from dense urban congestion. The surrounding infrastructure continues to evolve, reinforcing the area's appeal as a long-term residential destination. With its emphasis on space, nature, and thoughtful urban planning, Wadi Al Safa 3 offers an environment that supports wellbeing and long-term livability. Al Jaddaf offers a distinctive combination of heritage, culture, waterfront surroundings, and modern urban development. The Jameel Arts Centre contributes to the area's growing creative and cultural identity, creating an environment that extends beyond conventional residential living. The community continues to develop as a vibrant residential and commercial destination, with modern apartment buildings, waterfront residences, landscaped walkways, retail outlets, restaurants, and leisure facilities. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport is another major advantage, particularly for frequent travelers and international residents. With its central location, growing waterfront appeal, strong connectivity, and proximity to Dubai's established business and lifestyle districts, Al Jaddaf offers attractive long-term potential for both end-users and investors. title: DIFC Heights Tower
description:
DIFC Heights Tower is the second residential development from Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), following DIFC Living. The mixed-use tower stands on Al Mostaqbal Street in DIFC (Dubai International Financial Centre), between Index Tower and DAMAC Park Towers, and rises to ground plus 47 floors, with 32 residential floors and seven commercial floors. Its 366 homes range from one-bedroom apartments of 871 sq ft to four-bedroom duplexes of 3,618 sq ft, with two- and three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom duplexes in between.

Interiors use pastel tones, high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling glazing, and the homes are semi-furnished, with Bosch kitchen appliances in the apartments and Miele in the duplexes. Shared facilities include a gym, a temperature-controlled swimming pool, a separate kids' pool, a family lounge, an indoor kids' play area, a multipurpose hall and a co-working space, alongside landscaped terraces at the podium and amenity levels. The tower opens onto Gate Avenue at both ground and podium level, a Dubai Metro station is about five minutes on foot, Burj Khalifa and the Museum of the Future are around five minutes by car, and Dubai International Airport is roughly 20 minutes away.

DIFC is home to more than 46,000 professionals working across over 6,900 registered companies, so the homes sit close to a large and established workforce. The developer is the financial centre itself, and the building combines residences with offices and retail in a single address. The payment plan is 5% on booking, 65% during construction and 30% on handover, with completion expected in Q4 2029.

title: Damac Chic Tower
description:
Chic Tower is a DAMAC development in Business Bay, set on the Dubai Canal. The tower rises from a ground floor and five podium levels through 36 residential floors to a stepped roof, with undulating terraces that take their shape from the canal's waves. Its turquoise theme reflects the aesthetic of jeweller de GRISOGONO. The building holds around 450 homes: studios from 411 sq ft, one-bedroom apartments from 610 sq ft, two-bedroom apartments from 1,145 sq ft and a handful of three- and four-bedroom residences starting at 4,998 sq ft.

Homes are delivered unfurnished with fully equipped kitchens. The three- and four-bedroom units each have a planted terrace with an infinity pool, a personal gym and a projection screen. Wellness shapes the shared spaces: the lobby has workout benches and weights, and the podium holds seven baths, including hot, cold, salt and mud baths, a spa, a beauty bar and an outdoor calisthenics gym. Pools, cabanas, a juice bar, playgrounds, football pitches, party areas and a 180-metre lazy river complete it. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and DIFC are close by, and Dubai International Airport is about a 15-minute drive.

Business Bay and Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall metro stations are both nearby. The tower includes just three three-bedroom homes and one four-bedroom home. DAMAC, active in the region since 2002, reported around 42,000 homes delivered as of December 2021. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q4 2026. The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department, with its escrow account held at Mashreq Bank.

description: Reference: GTWW-T1212. Discover a new residential landmark in the heart of Dubai. An exceptional T1 with direct views of the canal, set in an iconic 450-metre, 109-storey tower that redefines the concept of living above the city. Located on the prestigious Sheikh Zayed Road, this development combines excellent architecture, stunning panoramic views and an immediate connection to the most relevant areas of the city. Just minutes from Business Bay, DIFC, Downtown and Jumeirah Beach, it offers a prime location that ensures mobility, convenience and the true experience of living in the centre of it all. This elegant 1 bedroom flat has 83 m² of gross area and 81 m² of living space, designed to maximise comfort, functionality and spaciousness. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame impressive views of the canal, allowing natural light to fill every space and creating a serene and inspiring atmosphere. The private balcony extends this connection to the landscape, offering the perfect setting for moments of rest or al fresco dining. The interior features high quality finishes: porcelain floors, a fully equipped kitchen with appliances from recognised brands and a bathroom covered with premium materials. The integrated technology allows lighting and climate control to be controlled, ensuring a modern, efficient environment that is fully adapted to the urban lifestyle. The building also offers four sky-parks distributed vertically, each one thought of as a universe suspended in the air. From family and leisure areas, to training and wellness areas, to tranquil elevated gardens for reading and reflection each space has been created to provide distinctive experiences at the top of the city. At the highest point, at about 370 meters, is a true resort environment with an infinity pool and floating deck, where the sunset over the horizon becomes part of the daily routine. The experience begins in the lobby, a space that combines stone, wood and metallic details to create a sense of tranquillity and grandeur, marking the architectural elegance of the project from the first step. The entire building was designed to convey harmony, verticality and lightness, transforming each route from the lobby to the highest levels into a natural extension of an urban and contemporary lifestyle. Scheduled for completion in December 2031, this T1 represents a unique investment opportunity in one of Dubai's tallest and most impressive residential projects.
